label: Geometric mean of QoR ratios
subgoals: Divide each candidate metric by its baseline
Average the logarithms of the ratios
Exponentiate the average to get the geometric mean

label: Reporting a percent change
subgoals: Subtract one from the geometric mean ratio
Multiply by 100 to get a signed percentage
Flag designs whose own ratio exceeds the tolerance

label: Why the geometric mean is symmetric
section: Why the geometric mean is symmetric
subgoals: Invert each ratio to compare in the other direction
Take the reciprocal of the geometric mean
Contrast with the arithmetic mean, which is not symmetric
